howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop one or more PDFs, up to 500 MB each. The same settings apply to all of them.

howto.name: Choose position and starting number
howto.text: Position: top-left/top-center/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-center/bottom-right. Starting number: defaults to 1, but use any whole number from 1 upward to continue a multi-document sequence. Font size: 12 pt by default, 6-48 pt on the slider.

howto.name: Apply and download
howto.text: PrivaTools stamps each page with its number in the chosen position and font size.

faq.q: Can I use Roman numerals or letters?
faq.a: No. Page numbers are Arabic digits only; Roman numerals and letters are not supported.

faq.q: How is this different from Bates numbering?
faq.a: Page numbers are simple sequential digits. Bates numbers have a prefix, configurable padding, and are used in legal contexts.

faq.q: Can I start from a specific page?
faq.a: Not directly: every page gets a number, and the first page gets the starting number you set. To leave a cover or contents pages unnumbered, split them off, number the rest from the right starting value, then merge the files back together.
